# Third-party code the console loads

Unchanged copies from npm, kept here so the console needs nothing from the internet.
An install records their hashes in MANIFEST.json, which each project's tests check.

| File | Package | Licence | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `3d-force-graph.min.js` | [3d-force-graph](https://github.com/vasturiano/3d-force-graph) 1.80.1 (bundles three.js) | MIT | `13088340aad408156064fd120c3bc3a47c93a3cc45b8f132d6284b20e2223be9` |
| `force-graph.min.js` | [force-graph](https://github.com/vasturiano/force-graph) 1.52.0 | MIT | `f59db59ba92ff5a76ed93d7a4d77a703b176260e5d9cd29f4f8eb4f6c369a629` |

To update: download the package's tarball from registry.npmjs.org, copy `dist/<name>.min.js` here, and
update this table.
